content.short: We are Remastering Iconic Browser Games Primed for Tokenization
content.description:
The inspiration for BananaClip stems from a passion for classic browser games that have captivated Billions (Yes, Billions!) worldwide. Despite their still growing popularity, which oftentimes trumps that of even the most popular AAA titles, these addicting classic games still have no economy for players to spend or earn .

Recognizing this gap, the BananaClip vision is one that harnesses the power of browser-game nostalgia and combines it with blockchain technology to create the premier destination for the next generation of iconic browser games. BananaClip introduces financial capabilities allowing players to earn, spend, bet against each other, and more – in a global, fully interoperable and seamless browser game haven.
